description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring an Associate Application Developer in its Oracle practice to help clients modernize enterprise business processes through Oracle applications. The role contributes to client application and cloud technology projects while developing technical and consulting expertise through hands-on work, mentorship, and structured learning.
Associate Application Developer supporting Oracle application modernization across enterprise finance, supply chain, and business processes

Responsibilities:
• As an Associate Application Developer at IBM, you'll help organizations transform how they serve customers, improve operations, and accelerate digital innovation through modern applications and cloud technologies
• No two projects are exactly alike. You could support healthcare, financial services, public sector, federal sector, automotive, energy, retail, industrial, or manufacturing clients
• As a parte of Oracle practice, focused on helping organizations modernize and optimize enterprise business processes through Oracle applications that support finance, supply chain, human resources, procurement, enterprise performance, and digital transformation
• During your first year, you'll build technical expertise, earn certifications, contribute to client projects, strengthen your consulting and communication skills, and establish a strong foundation for long-term career growth at IBM

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Currently completing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
• Foundational knowledge of programming languages such as Java, SQL, Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies
• Understanding of software development fundamentals, databases, APIs, cloud computing, and enterprise applications
• Exposure to application development, data, or cloud-related projects through coursework, internships, research, or personal learning
• Familiarity with Git or similar version control tools
• Curiosity about enterprise technologies, Artificial Intelligence, cloud solutions, and digital transformation
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Exposure to Oracle technologies, enterprise applications, databases, or cloud platforms
• Familiarity with ERP systems, business applications, integrations, or modern application architectures
• Interest in Oracle solutions, Artificial Intelligence, and continuous learning
